description:
Project Overview

This TU Delft PhD investigates whether visible changes in microorganisms can reveal past environmental conditions. The research explores biological alternatives to disposable electronic data loggers.

Research Position Overview

Grow organisms, record their responses and develop image-based decoders. Test living-sensor prototypes, including possible compostable packaging for temperature and humidity monitoring.

Research Areas

  • Biodesign and living materials
  • Computer vision and machine learning
  • Biological sensing and memory
